You need to fill in three bracketed placeholders before you paste it, or it could cause chaos or get rejected by SRE:

1. **`[Target Version/Tag]`** — Specify the exact build/version/tag they must roll back to.
2. **`[Namespace/Target IDs]`** — Specify the exact cluster, namespace, and volume targets so they don't wipe the wrong data.
3. **`[Link]`** — Drop the link to the actual incident thread or bridge (or delete that line if not using one).

If you don't know the exact version or volume IDs right this second, write **"per Marcus / Incident Command specifications"** or reference the last known stable tag directly, but **do not post raw brackets**—SRE won't know what to roll back to or what to purge. 

Also, explicitly mention **"per Marcus"** in the text so full operational authorization is pinned to him.
